name: Taira Akira
source:
Tyler was a chubby child, but grown up into a handsome young man. Though, his personality stays a kid: foolish, passionate, and simple. Also energetic.

He always come in ready for trekking, with his true identity being a natural born treasure hunting idiot. He spends his summer vacation immersing himself in various treasure hunting in Tokyo.

He went to the same elementary school as Hilda and Leona.

Favorites: Treasure hunting, Sentai hero shows
